# Along (actdim-along) - Full LLM Reference

> Comprehensive architectural, protocol, skill, and API reference for AI coding agents operating on or using Along.

## 1. Project Purpose & Architecture
Along is a provider-agnostic agent-context and memory protocol (`ALONG-PROTOCOL v2.2.15`) that gives repositories a durable, versioned context directory (`.along/`), compiled Knowledge Base (`docs/`), and an executive dashboard suite.

### Host Provider Compatibility
- **Claude Code**: Reads `CLAUDE.md`, which imports root `AGENTS.md`. Skills located in `~/.claude/skills/`.
- **Codex**: Reads `AGENTS.md` natively. Skills located in `~/.codex/skills/`.
- **OpenCode**: Reads `AGENTS.md` natively. Flat command definitions in `~/.config/opencode/commands/`.
- **Antigravity**: Reads `AGENTS.md` / `GEMINI.md` natively. Skills located in `~/.gemini/config/skills/`.

---

## 2. Dynamic Dashboard & Knowledge Base Engine (`/along-dash`)

### Backend Architecture (`dashboard/`)
- **FastAPI Application (`dashboard/app.py`)**: REST endpoints and live Server-Sent Events (SSE) stream on `http://127.0.0.1:8765`.
- **OpenAPI Schema & Swagger UI**: Auto-generated interactive API documentation available at `/docs` and `/openapi.json`.
- **REST Endpoints**:
  - `GET /api/data`: Full repository snapshot (metrics, issues, milestones, risks, spikes, sessions, decisions, KB articles, and graph).
  - `GET /api/kb`: List all Knowledge Base articles with type and tag filters.
  - `GET /api/kb/search?q={query}&type={type}`: Fast search engine across articles, issues, ADRs, and sessions.
  - `GET /api/kb/graph`: Cross-link connectivity graph.
  - `GET /api/metrics`: High-level progress percentages and issue distributions.
  - `GET /api/events`: SSE stream broadcasting file modification events (`reload`).

### Frontend Architecture (`packages/dashboard-ui/`)
- **Strict Reactive Component Model (`@actdim/dynstruct`)**: All state resides in observable `c.model` (MobX) with structure-first definitions. Zero raw React `useState` or `useEffect`.
- **Type-Safe Messaging Bus (`@actdim/msgmesh`)**: Inter-component messaging and API queries routed through `dashboardBus` via dynamic adapters (`@actdim/msgmesh/adapters`).
- **Interactive Visualizations**: Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) rendered with Cytoscape, Kanban view of issues, sessions journal, and fast search modal (`SearchModal`).

---

## 3. Knowledge Base Structure (`docs/` & `.archive/`)
- `INDEX.md`: Central topic index with relative Markdown links (`[Title](./target.md)`).
- `topic--architecture.md`: System components, boundaries, protocol layers, and data flows.
- `topic--domain-model.md`: Domain entity schemas (Issue, Milestone, Risk, Spike, Session, ADR) and DAG relationships.
- `topic--setup-and-workflow.md`: Multi-provider setup, standard session workflow, and CLI reference.
- `topic--frontend-frameworks.md`: Dynstruct, MsgMesh, Material UI adapters, and NSwag code generation.
- `topic--dependencies.md`: Discovered AI guidelines from installed packages (`AGENTS.md`, `llms.txt`).
- `.archive/`: Isolated raw source documents and notes excluded from active search.

---

## 4. Skills & Slash Commands Reference (Singular Domain-First)

| Skill | Slash Command | Execution | Purpose |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `along-init` | `/along-init` | `along-init` | Scaffolds or refreshes `.along/` and `AGENTS.md`. |
| `along-update` | `/along-update` | `python scripts/along_update.py` | One-liner update of repo protocol and global skills. |
| `along-dash` | `/along-dash` | `python scripts/along_dash.py -w` | Launches dynamic FastAPI dashboard with OpenAPI docs and UI. |
| `along-kb-sync` | `/along-kb-sync` | `python skills/along-kb-sync/along_kb_sync.py` | Idempotent LLM-Wiki Knowledge Base compiler. |
| `along-kb-search` | `/along-kb-search` | `python skills/along-kb-search/along_kb_search.py` | Fast targeted structured retrieval across docs. |
| `along-dep-scan` | `/along-dep-scan` | `python skills/along-dep-scan/along_dep_scan.py` | Discovers AI guidelines in declared dependencies. |
| `along-version-bump` | `/along-version-bump` | `python scripts/along_version_bump.py patch -c` | Increments version across manifests and files. |
| `along-commit` | `/along-commit` | `python skills/along-commit/along_commit.py` | ASCII sanitizer, pre-commit test gate, and conventional committer. |
| `along-wrap` | `/along-wrap` | `along-wrap` | Unified session wrap: verification, session log, context, issues reconciliation. |
| `along-graph-check` | `/along-graph-check` | `along-graph-check` | Inspects code-review-graph status, blast radius, and architecture flows. |
